nina: FYI nightly bringup flagged weird subtitle pacing for nova-lite q4 on mixed JA+ZH episodes. cues skewed earlier and some short cues collapsed into previous line. quick dump below.
hiro: ok can you paste the reproducible command?
nina: `./tools/sub_eval.py --model nova-lite-q4 --quant int4 --input samples/multi_ja_zh/ep03.srt --log-tokens --out /tmp/out.srt`
sara: any sign it's detok (ZWJ/ZWSP) or token merge at decode?
nina: logs show merged tokens around timecode boundaries and fullwidth quote chars. example:
```
[decode] step=7 token_id=50012 token_str="00:00:45,120-->00:00:45,520「"
[decode] step=8 token_id=300 token_str="行く"
```
so the left timecode + arrow + opening quote got emitted as one token. serializer assumes token->cue mapping -> earlier end time.
hiro: is the same in float16?
nina: float16 keeps separate tokens: "00:00:45"," ,120","-->","00:00:45"," ,520","\n","\u300c". looks int4-specific.
eval-bot: alert: subtitle_timing_regression (mean_delta=-0.43s) on branch bringup/nova-lite-q4 for locales [ja, zh-Hans]. confidence=0.92.
sara: could be vocab remap in quant stage or an optimization that hooks frequent grapheme runs into single ids. useful to grep the qvocab remap table for patterns like `-->` or `:`.
build-bot: CI note: qvocab remap patch r3245 introduced aggressive merge pruning for low-memory int4 decoding.
nina: interesting. quick local bisect: running decode with `--force-tokenizer=host-bpe` to see if runtime remap is the cause.
sara: also try `--disable-qvocab-remap` if available.
hiro: mitigation for downstream: make SRT serializer prefer regex-extracted timestamps first (\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2},\d{3}) then fall back to token-offset mapping. less fragile.
nina: opened PR in parsers to apply regex-first fallback. small patch so streaming caption customers don't see shifted cues.
sara: longer term we should avoid emitting combined timecode+arrow tokens during decoding. assign to me + nina to bisect r3245 -> r3252.
eval-bot: note: no RTL locales flagged yet, but add zh-Hant to the eval set for next night to cover Traditional Han.
hiro: thanks. extra test: add short-dialogue stress tests with quotes and punctuation adjacent to timecodes; those are most sensitive.
nina: will add tests to `tests/subtitles/edge_cases` and re-run nightly. keeping thread updated.
